seed_data.title: Lucamar Baalm 50g  UNSCENTED
seed_data.description:
Uncover the classic power of our Skin Baalm, a refined blend of lanolin and hemp seed oil, designed to care for skin, hands, beards and tattoo's. 

This luxurious balm draws from time-honoured grooming traditions, deeply moisturising and restoring with every use. Lanolin's rich emollient properties work to soften & protect, while the nourishing essence of hemp seed oil helps to rejuvenate and maintain healthy skin. 

Whether soothing dry, cracked hands, taming facial hair, or enhancing the vibrancy of your tattoo, this balm delivers the care your body deserves. 

A timeless companion for the modern man, embracing the strength and elegance of old-world craftsmanship with every application. 

INGREDIENTS: 

Pure Australian Anhydrous Lanolin, Humanely Sourced Vitellaria paradoxa. Organic Shea Butter , Australian Hemp extract. Cera Alba, Australian Bees Wax, Vitamin A, E, Frankincense & Ginger Body Safe fragrance 

No parabéns, petrolatum, Peg's, Mineral oil, sulphates. 

DAILY RITUAL: 

Soften balm between hands and apply on the required areas. Only a little is needed as it goes a long way . 

Proudly Made In South Australia 

Cruelty Free

seed_data.title: Musk: My Lips Are Sealed Lip Balm 10gms
seed_data.description:
NATURAL & ORGANIC LIP BALM 10g 

Unveil the timeless secret to soft, supple lips with this vintage inspired Lanolin Lip Balm. 

Infused with pure lanolin, this rich emollient lip balm deeply nourishes & protects, soothing dry chapped lips. 

Its silky smooth texture glides on effortlessly, forming a protective barrier that locks in moisture and restores your lips natural softness. 

Treat your lips to the nourishment they deserve. 

Lanolin used in all our products is humanely sourced from Australian sheep farmers. 

Our Lip Balm is cruelty free and never tested on animals. 

Proudly Made In Australia 

Ingredients 

Lanolin Anhydrous, Pure Australian Lanolin, Vitellaria Paradora, Organic Shea Butter, Cera Alba,Bees Wax, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis , Australian almond oil,Vitamin A,E , Malva Moschatus Musk 

No Artificial flavouring, parabéns, petrolatum, Peg's, Mineral oil, sulphates

seed_data.title: 7 Journeys Antarctic Timeless Serum 45ml (Hydration & Anti-aging)
seed_data.description:
Discover long-lasting hydration and skin comfort with the 7 Journeys Antarctic Timeless Serum 45ml. Formulated with Antarcticine® (Pseudoalteromonas Ferment Extract), this serum helps skin retain moisture, supporting a smooth and nourished appearance. The formula combines niacinamide, tranexamic acid, and vitamin C to help even the look of skin tone and improve overall brightness.

Superfruits like acai, blueberry, and strawberry provide antioxidant support, while panthenol, allantoin, and mango seed butter help soothe and replenish skin. A blend of multi-peptides further enhances hydration, promoting soft, healthy-looking skin texture. Lightweight and quickly absorbed, this serum layers easily under moisturizer or makeup, making it an ideal addition to your daily routine.

Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, and carefully crafted without parabens, sulfates, silicones, or added fragrances. Vegan-certified and cruelty-free, this serum is perfect for anyone seeking a clean, refreshing boost to their skincare regimen.

Hydrating serum powered by Antarcticine® for lasting moisture

Niacinamide and tranexamic acid help refine and brighten skin appearance

Superfruits and peptides nourish and support skin barrier

Lightweight texture absorbs quickly, suitable for layering

Vegan, fragrance-free, paraben-free, sulfate-free
